headline: The Mayflower Compact is signed
post_facts: Signed aboard the Mayflower off Cape Cod
41 men put their names to it

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in sixteen twenty... off Cape Cod, forty-one men signed a promise.

scenes.label: Off Cape Cod
scenes.caption: Painting by Jean Leon Gerome Ferris
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] The Mayflower had landed far north of Virginia, where it was headed.

scenes.label: men signed the Mayflower Compact
scenes.text: [calmly] To keep order, they agreed to make laws together, and obey them.

scenes.label: 1920 U.S. stamp
scenes.caption: The signing, on a 300th anniversary stamp
scenes.title: Plymouth's first rules
scenes.text: [softly] It became Plymouth Colony's first governing document.

scenes.title: An early step toward self-government
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] An early step toward American self-government.
